title: RTI Act Explained: What You Can Ask, How to File RTI Online and What to Do If There's No Reply
seoTitle: How to File RTI Online: Fees, Time Limits and Appeals
seoDescription: File RTI online at rtionline.gov.in for ₹10 (free for BPL). The PIO must reply in 30 days; if not, file a free first appeal, then go to the CIC or SIC.
excerpt: Step-by-step filing on the central portal, every legal deadline in one table, how first and second appeals work, Section 8 and Section 24 exemptions, and what the 2019 and DPDP Act changes mean for you.
